title.zh: Show HN: Capsule – Single-file web apps that save their data into SQLite
title.en: Show HN: Capsule – Single-file web apps that save their data into SQLite

current_state.zh: Capsule is a Rust/Tauri 2.0 tool that packs an HTML app and its data into a single SQLite file, supporting localStorage-style key/value storage, a MongoDB-inspired collections API, embedded assets, and CSV/JSON export.
